description: Create a new project (INV-7 tenant primitive). Idempotent on project_id — re-creating an existing project returns the existing row. The 'default' project is seeded on Open and cannot be re-created (returns ErrAlreadyExists).

auth_token.description: Bearer token; never echoed in tool results.

constitution_id.description: Optional constitution id to bind the project to (INV-7 constitution scoping).

default_agent_id.description: Optional v2.4.1 Mem0 agent_id (LLM identity) that owns the project. session_start and publish_vibe resolve agent_id with priority (caller input > this default > empty). Empty = no default agent (v2.4.0 behavior). Set this for multi-agent projects so each LLM's ContextRecap and drift_judge enrichment filter to its own memories.

nli_config.description: Optional v2.20.0 T07 per-project NLI configuration. When enabled, the project's drift_judge uses the configured primary (and optional fallback) NLI provider instead of falling through to nli.Config{}.DefaultsFor().

project_id.description: Kebab-case public id (3-64 chars, lowercase alnum + hyphen, must start and end with alnum).

name: dark_memory_project_create
